item.description:
Dax 3.9.12

  • Dax finds Codex, Claude Code and every other agent wherever you installed them. Agents installed with npm under nvm, fnm, volta or asdf, or added to your PATH in ~/.zshrc, now show up in New project. While Dax looks, the agent reads “Searching”; if it truly isn’t there you get Install and Locate….
  • Hold Control-Shift to talk to a pane, and let go to send. On Pro, the Mac now dictates through Deepgram, the same as the phone.
  • Agents show their plans as artifacts over a blurred screen, with Approve and Change. This works for Claude, Codex and any other agent.
  • Settings › Appearance › Tab colour has a new “Same colour” choice: every tab and folder wears your accent.
  • Dax Companion 1.7 floats a live picture of your Mac in a corner of the phone. Browser panes show their page title, favicon and tab count in the agent list.
